snippet.title: AS THE WHEEL SPINS - Dusttale Non est Deus teaser
snippet.description:
CONTRADICTION ; TWO OPPOSING NATURES
AS THE WHEEL SPINS, TWISTING, TURNING LIKE A KNIFE
WE BEGIN TO ALL BUT PONDER THIS NULL JUXTAPOSE
CAN I BE AS MY GOD AM?
CAN YOU BE AS GOD AM?
THE NOBILITY IS NIGH, BUT FATE REQUIRES A VICTOR
NULL IS ALL MORALS IN THIS IGNORANT WORLD
